description: Next earnings date (SEC) — Projects a US-listed company's next earnings release from its own SEC filing history: matches every 8-K Item 2.02 earnings release to its fiscal period end, handles calendar-quarter and 52/53-week fiscal years, and returns the next period end, expected release date with earliest/latest window, the 10-Q/10-K filing deadline for its filer category, release history with lag days, and a status (UPCOMING, SOON, DUE ANY DAY, LATE VS PATTERN). Params: ticker (or cik). Estimate only - companies set exact dates. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_earnings_calendar
